name: inventory-web
description: نظام إدارة المخزون — Inventory Management System (Arabic / RTL web app: Vercel + Railway + Supabase)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts._comment_db_provision: Creates the development database inside the container, so a dev machine needs no local sqlcmd. Arabic_CI_AS matches what provision-mssql.sql gives the server; the collation is worth having right in development, since it decides how Arabic names sort and compare.
scripts.db:provision: docker exec inventory-db /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P DevPassw0rd! -C -Q "IF DB_ID('inventory') IS NULL CREATE DATABASE inventory COLLATE Arabic_CI_AS"
scripts._comment_build: Installs the client's dependencies first, so a host that builds from the repository root (rather than with its root directory set to client/) still finds tsc and vite.
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build

author: Inventory Systems
